decisions.reason: The border-removal decision also applies to the Zebra print, but its existing message 34 MODIFY already records border_enabled as false, removes the obsolete border attributes, and records full-edge artwork.
The no-border decision concerns the Zebra and Weave repeat designs. The same message explicitly retains the 7 cm and 17 cm border measurements for the block-color pareos.

Removing borders from the repeat artwork does not alter the CMYK, Pantone, ICC-profile, or color-reference requirements.
